title: Better Multiplayer - GF
description: Make vanila mutiplayer feel better by adding some custom function
body:
---
# ⚑ About This Datapack:
> This datapack transforms your single-player world with exciting features and makes playing with friends on a multiplayer server even more enjoyable.

# ✿ Features:
* **TopBoard**: Rotating side scoreboards (Deaths, Kills, Mob Slayer) and under-name stats (HP, Level)
* **BedTime**: Sleeping accelerates time instead of skipping it, with random sleep messages
* **Notification**: Scheduled chat messages for tips or announcements
* **Server System**: Player join messages with stats and Discord link support
* **Warp**: Player-to-player teleport request system with accept/deny option
* **Player Menu**: Toggle glowing, select particle effects via in-game UI
<details>
<summary>[Check Detail]</summary>
  
## 💾 Server ❁
> When a player joins the world for the first time, a message will be announced to everyone in chat.

![bmp_Server_FirstJoin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cad5968e766d69d9daa19bf3a44a5e4614399627.jpeg)
---
> This welcome message appears when a player rejoins the world. It displays key personal stats in a styled format, including:
* 🧍 **Username**
* ⏱️ **Playtime**
* 🧪 **Level & Experience**
* ⚔️ **Kills & Deaths**
* 💬 **Discord link**

![bmp_Server_Welcomback](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5dadb977b043a35cfd52cfbcaa87ffbe6bff1509.jpeg)

>It helps players quickly review their progress and reconnect with the server community.

---

## 🛏️ BedTime ❁
> This feature set `gamerule playersSleepingPercentage` to `999`, which means players can no longer skip the night by sleeping.  
> However, whenever any player goes to sleep, time will start speeding up depending on how many players are currently sleeping. (For each sleeping player, time accelerates by `50 ticks`.)

![bmp_BedTime_Showcase](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEisFMFCyZalc4cBl1G62w3PBo0tRtj1edjXB3PLIakwbpdRin-aG0BkghHPjsk8yIf_WQOu7gkQtxDc7-1PRQvzAXbjwuhGUYNJuRnZ9Hw3RT_kKcsdwH5YG14mN2AjjNjl7dRXM010eeDm1Ktv41S5EN9sOe3f_RjiXh3SnKmm4-4spaChID9RRhbrr_JO/w900-h300/BedTime_01.gif)

> A chat message is also displayed when someone goes to sleep.

---

## 💬 Notification ❁
> Sends tips and announcements to all players every `7 hours`. Runs silently in the background.

---
</details>

# ⌨︎ Commands:
New commands will be available using ```/trigger <name>``` to perform specific actions based on each command.

<details>
<summary>[See All Command]</summary>

## 🧍 Player Menu ⊞
Type this command ```/trigger bmp:player``` for open menu. You will change "Things" for this menu

---
## 🔮 Warp (TPA) ⊞
Use this command ```/trigger bmp:warp set <id>``` to teleport to other player
> Replace `<id>` with the player’s ID to send a teleport request.  
> You can find the **Player ID** in the list.

---
  
## ❌ Uninstallation ⊞
Only **Admin** or **Oparetor** can run this command
```
#Check Version
/function bmp:version

#Delete Datapack
/function bmp:remove
```
</details>
